# CoLab

> > A comprehensive scientific publication search and discovery platform spanning all research disciplines with advanced citation metrics and researcher tools.

CoLab provides researchers with integrated access to scientific publications, citation data, and research metrics across multidisciplinary fields. The platform combines publication discovery with academic indexing capabilities to support open-access research exploration.

## Key Topics

- Scientific publication database
- Research search and discovery
- Citation metrics
- Academic indexing
- Multidisciplinary research
- Open-access publishing
- Researcher tools
- Cobalt search engine
- Journal archives
- Publication metrics
- ORCID integration
- SCImago indexing
- Nature Index
- Web of Science compatibility

## Core Search & Discovery

- [Cobalt](https://cobalt.colab.ws/): Comprehensive scientific publication search engine across all research fields with advanced discovery and filtering capabilities

## Journal Archives

- [Mendeleev Communications 2026 Issues](https://mendcomm.colab.ws/issues/2026): 2026 issues archive for Mendeleev Communications chemistry journal with access to published research volumes
